briefdescription.para: Compute the Mahalanobis distance analysis of another State with respect to this State's Covariance.

detaileddescription.para: Both States are expressed in the Covariance frame and reduced to the given coordinate subsets, which must be present in both States (other subsets may differ). The residuals (other - this) are then analyzed against the Covariance reduced to the same coordinate subsets.

The coordinate subsets to compute the analysis for

briefdescription.para: Trajectory state at a given instant in time.

detaileddescription.para: Represents the complete state of an object at a specific instant, consisting of coordinates (such as position, velocity, attitude, angular velocity, etc.) expressed in a given reference frame. The coordinates are defined by a set of coordinate subsets managed through a CoordinateBroker.
